daily_base_probability_source.calibration_semantics: Training-only quantile edges are built from remaining_inertia; each test fold receives its training-bin rate shrunk toward the training global rate as (train_rate*train_n + global_rate*20)/(train_n+20); missing mapped bins fall back to the training global rate.

components.known: Historical accepted framework exposes Structure, Inertia and Execution views plus P-up/P-range/P-down style probability outputs and key validation levels.
components.missing: Exact full-strategy layer aggregation and exact mapping from the final 12-factor score/state to the three-way probability output remain unrecovered.

components.known: V3.10 has executable training-only walk-forward calibration that converts frozen Daily Base remaining_inertia buckets into binary target probabilities for six exact targets, with default 720-day minimum training history, 63-day steps, ten training quantile bins, target-specific purge/embargo and 20-row-equivalent shrinkage toward the training base rate.
components.missing: The recovered calibration is Daily Base only and does not recover the final GP12 P-up/P-range/P-down three-way probability mapping, its final score inputs, or any post-Daily incremental-layer recalibration contract.

components.known: V3.10 uses exact-horizon executable masks and future suspension/limit/delist diagnostics to separate label existence from execution friction; EVENT_CLEAN folds also exclude event-contaminated exact horizons.
components.missing: The recovered source explicitly says these are diagnostics rather than actual fill-price mechanics; limit-up/down fill rules, intraday/order-book execution, slippage and final entry/exit fills remain separate.

components.known: Cross-sectional panel outputs and score buckets exist in Daily Base, but no authoritative historical final Top-N selection rule is recovered.
components.missing: Exact historical rank key, tie-break rule, Top-N count, rebalance interaction and eligibility ordering are missing. Candidate Top-N=10 is a 2026-09-09 proposal and is not historical authority.

components.known: Recovered packages contain forecast labels and execution-risk diagnostics but no authoritative full-strategy entry/exit score thresholds.
components.missing: Exact historical entry threshold, exit threshold, stop/invalidity semantics and interaction with Structure/Inertia/Execution are missing. Candidate entry>=60 and exit<45 are rejected as historical parameters.

components.known: Historical Daily Base evaluates T+1/T+2/T+3 forecast targets and exact market-day horizons.
components.missing: T+1/T+2/T+3 forecast horizons are not a holding policy. Exact maximum/minimum holding time, rebalance cadence, early exit, carry-forward and suspended-name handling for the strategy remain unrecovered; candidate max holding=3 is proposal-only.

components.known: The accepted framework treats market environment and execution as risk-control context, but no complete position-sizing implementation is recovered from the historical packages.
components.missing: Per-name cap, sector cap, capital-at-risk rule, portfolio gross/net exposure, drawdown response and adverse-move action are missing. Candidate 10% name cap, 20% sector cap, 1% capital risk and 8% adverse-move rule are proposal-only.
